name: developer-terminal-hero
title: Developer Terminal Hero
description: Hero layout with code terminal on right showing instant pnpm install and validation commands.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Copyable Terminal Hero: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
